title: The Frontier Lord Begins with Zero Subjects: Tales of Blue Dias and the Onikin Alna
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Manga adaptation of a light novel. After decades of war, the soldier Dias returns home a hero and is granted a domain that turns out to be empty grassland with no subjects. Unsure how to live as anything but a soldier, he meets Alna, a horned Onikin girl, and begins building a frontier community; database tags list marriage, adoption and a found family (J-Novel Club blurb; MU and AniList tags).
life_message: A kind, hard-working life of building a home and community matters more than military glory.
